purpose: Source-bound selected AC1024 MATERIAL DWG replay, dictionary/XRECORD dependency closure, and independent peer readback.

source.producer_claim: Repository README identifies trial AutoCAD 2016 M.49.0.0.
source.qualification: AC1024 format witness, not a verified AutoCAD 2010 RTM witness.
